deterministic_checks.message: [RS-27 Schema validity] All 7 structured artifacts validate against the v0.2.0 schemas.
[RS-07 Objective referential integrity] Every objective_id cited by 4 content units, 58 items and 24 claims resolves in the registry (8 nodes in this topic branch, 7 assessable).
[RS-07 Claim referential integrity] Every claim_id cited by a content-unit block or learning item exists in the topic ledger.
[RS-07 Claim orphans] All 24 ledger claims are cited by at least one block or item.
[RS-40 Meaningful objective mapping] Every (item, objective) mapping is backed by a cited claim that serves that objective.
[RS-05 Coverage floor - items (meaningful mappings only)] All 7 assessable objectives are practised by at least one item under RS-40.
[RS-05 Coverage floor - content units] All 7 assessable objectives are taught by at least one content unit.
[RS-39 Offline reconstructibility] Every claim cited by a learning item is also taught in a content-unit block.
[RS-41 No bulk stamp] All 86 stamped artefacts are consistent: every advanced stamp is matched by changed text or by a recorded reviewed_unchanged decision.
[RS-41 No stale derivative] No stale derivative: every block and item was authored against the current revision of every claim it cites.
[RS-17 Syllabus modality coverage] Every objective whose syllabus wording names a chart, graph or diagram is practised in that form.
[RS-22 Stated arithmetic is correct] All 0 stated calculations in canonical answers evaluate correctly.
[RS-25 Flashcards are self-contained] No flashcard depends on facts held only in another card.
[RS-22 Interpretation is interpretation, not a second check] No quantitative item passes off an arithmetic check as interpretation.
[RS-22 Graphical stimulus is consistent and necessary] No graphical task in this topic, so nothing to verify.
[RS-22 Magnitude claims carry their figure] Every magnitude claim in a quantitative answer is backed by a stated figure.
[RS-33 Unqualified universals] No unqualified universal or exclusivity statement found in claims, learner prose or answers.
[RS-21 Third-party certainty] No statement asserts a third party's decision as certain.
[RS-36 Assessment-priority claims need assessment evidence] No learner-facing claim about examiner behaviour, mark priority or question frequency.
[RS-15 Scope discipline - excluded constructs] None of the 8 constructs the contract excludes appears in learner-facing material.
[RS-35 Variant completeness] Every variant-register term used in this topic names its consequential forms.
[RS-34 Generalisations declare their scope] Every grouping or across-the-board statement declares the members it claims to hold for.
[RS-19 Command-word discipline] No item prompt instructs with a command word absent from this level (Discuss).
[RS-37 Command-word-shaped practice] Every objective with a command word carries an item that instructs with one of them.
[RS-38 Declared answer structures] Every item names all declared parts of its subtype answer structure.
[RS-19 Subtype to AO consistency] Every item's assessment objectives are permitted by its subtype.
[RS-19 AO mix against target] The framework declares no AO target share.
[RS-25 Flashcard integrity] All 32 flashcards carry a non-null canonical answer and a declared subtype.
[RS-25 One target per flashcard] 1 flashcards ask for several separate answers in one card, which is hard to retrieve and hard to diagnose; consider a performance item instead.
[RS-25 Duplicate prompts] No exact duplicate and no near-duplicate prompt pair above 0.85 Jaccard across 58 items.
[RS-30 Marking guidance present] All 58 items carry marking guidance.
[RS-12 Items cite a claim] Every item cites at least one ledger claim.
[RS-13 Publication gate] Gate holds: 0 of 24 claims are publishable or verified. 24 are generated_gap and need documented human approval (RS-13).
[RS-31 QA status consistency] Every content unit and item carries a recognised qa_status.
[RS-09 Word budget] All 4 content units sit inside their declared word budget (2394 words total).
[RS-05 Exposure required subtypes] Every exposure-required subtype is present or waived in writing.

[RS-32 Packet hash manifest] Critic-packet hash manifest written for 29 files to topics/1.4/packet.sha256; the manifest's own SHA-256 is detached in packet.sha256.hash (99a1e49d8cea0dd5) so the whole packet is verifiable.
[RS-43 Conditioned mechanisms carry their conditions] No artefact asserts any of the 3 registered conditioned mechanisms in this topic.
[RS-44 Answers do not supply their own facts] No answer in this topic asserts a completeness fact.
[RS-45 Derived exposure metadata recomputes] Exposure map or assessment evidence absent, so derived metrics cannot be recomputed.
[RS-46 Quantities are named in their own units] No quantity is named in units it is not measured in.
[RS-47 Depictions are generated, not authored] No item in this topic shows a generated depiction.
[RS-45 Contract counts match the live build] All 3 counts the contract authorises match the build: 58 learning items, 4 content units.
[RS-48 Practice texts are declared, original and the stated length] All 12 practice texts cited by 24 items exist, declare themselves original and sit inside their stated length.

blockers: No deterministic opinion on 4 checks (C-35, C-18, C-39, C-41) - on these a human or model reviewer is the only line of defence.
RS-28 - no semantic review has run on this topic yet. Under the amended RS-42 that does not hold publication; it schedules one.
notes: Standard v0.2.0-draft check suite. 44 checks: 39 pass, 0 fail, 1 warn, 4 not_run.
A not_run check means an input the check needs is absent. It is never a pass.
RS-30: these are mechanical results computed by code. They say nothing about whether the material teaches the subject well.
